spans.text: At the café.
Right in front of the vacant counter, AR15 sits alone in the corner, sulking in silence.
You drop by a bar and won't even bother to order something?
...It's not like Dolls need alcohol.
Annoyed, AR15 waves her off, cutting M16's attempt to pat her head short.
You've come to laugh at me?
Laugh? What's there to laugh about?
M16 chuckles, then greets the bartender.
Two whiskeys, please.
Acting all smug and confident beforehand, only to have my ass handed to me like that. Even I find that laughable.
We passed, isn't that what counts?
M16 scratches her head.
Besides, that was the fruit of our entire team's effort, now you're making it your personal burden?
Ding.
Clear glasses holding yellow liquor slide right in front of the two, both topped with ice balls pressed into a perfectly spherical shape.
When you need to relax like a human, you say “Dolls don't need alcohol”.
When you need to be cold and calculating like a Doll, you put all the blame on yourself.
Getting the short end of the stick of both sides, yeesh...
I'm not—
M16 smiles, holding her glass up, then downs it with a single gulp.
M4 asked me to bring you back. She seems to be very happy that we've accomplished a mission together for the first time.
Now that I've delivered the message, it's up to you whether you're coming or not.
I heard there's a rehearsal after the celebration, you know?
Looking at M16 slowly fading into the distance, AR15 remains wordless for a solid period, until the ice in her glass melts and collides with the wall with a crisp cling.
Suddenly, she raises her glass, and, just like M16, downs the rest of her liquor forcibly.
...I'll be damned if they can somehow rehearse the test without me.
Mumbling, she stands up and leaves the bar as well.
